intentions.title: Give Studio a Notion/Sanity-grade multi-pane CMS shell (Structure → Type → Documents → Editor) that mirrors the TUI's pane drill-down
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex is the LiveView shell after a god-module decomposition into StudioLive.Handlers.* (Scope, Fields, Media, Refs, History, Delete, Discard, Doc, Shares, ItemShare, Schema, Secondary, Bulk, Paper) with shared state in StudioLive.Shared; moduledoc explicitly says it mirrors the TUI's pane structure.

intentions.title: Enforce that every hidden Studio affordance is also server-denied — hidden capability chrome is never trusted as the security boundary
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex mount/1 comment 'ag-studio-capability-hide: the LOAD-BEARING server-side deny-gate' — Caps.attach() re-derives caps per event so a forged event for a hidden affordance is denied; access grants and expiry ticks (load_access_grants, schedule_access_expiry, refresh_grant_access) rebuild caller_context from the DB so an expired/revoked grant stops serving rows without requiring reconnect.

intentions.title: Ship a full in-browser spreadsheet editor (Sheets M2-M4) with formula engine, per-user undo/redo, live collaborator presence, and a published-only read-only reader, all wired through op-based sync rather than shared client state
intentions.evidence: sheet_grid.ex: every edit becomes a Sheets.Session.apply_ops/3 call; the LiveComponent never applies an op to its own assigns, only forwards session deltas via send_update; read_only hosts get PUBLISHED-ONLY content and Ops.send_ops/2 drops mutations server-side; presence rendered on a dedicated peer_layer to avoid re-rendering the whole grid at ~10fps; undo/redo stamped per-user via 'user' field.

intentions.title: Make the Studio's document blast-radius (dependency graph) inspectable via a self-contained, dependency-free force-directed graph renderer
intentions.evidence: graph_view.ex: Cytoscape fully gutted in favor of a hand-rolled vanilla Canvas2D velocity-Verlet force sim in bp-graph.js (ZERO npm/network deps); server derives only topology + root id (derive in update/2 never render/1 to preserve LiveView change tracking); root pinned dead-center with BFS blast-ring banding; phantom nodes for dangling FK targets rendered dashed/muted.

intentions.title: Let every composite/array/codelist/localized-text field type in the Papers block editor be edited in-canvas without losing input focus on server echo
intentions.evidence: paper_field_block.ex: nested LiveComponent per composite block type (composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText) targeting @myself; local-first value update before sending :paper_op so the server echo is a no-op diff for the touched input (caret preserved); @max_array_index guard (10_000) prevents a crafted bracket-index form key from OOM-ing the BEAM.

intentions.title: Turn Studio into a first-class agentic workspace — a persisted, resumable Claude Code chat with mission-control agent rail, plan-as-Papers, and a real host terminal, gated admin-only and off by default on public demos
intentions.evidence: chat_live.ex: sessions are addressable places (StudioChat) resumable via CLI --resume, subprocess spawned lazily on first send never on mount; agents rail (rail/rail_sig/rail_expanded) mirrors Claude-Code-TUI mission control; needs_you_roles (approval/question/plan) gate identically; tmux_live.ex hosts a real PTY (xterm.js + TmuxTerminal hook) surviving reconnects; both ChatLive and TmuxLive gate via ClaudeChat.enabled?/TmuxConsole.enabled? which hard-refuse public-demo hosts.

intentions.title: Give organization admins self-serve enterprise-identity control (SSO, SCIM directory sync, member/role visibility, audit log) without engineering involvement
intentions.evidence: org_admin_live.ex: admin-gated portal surfacing OIDC/SAML config, one-click SCIM token minting (plaintext shown once), member counts, and audit log; mint_scim and toggle_require_mfa handlers back onto Barkpark.Scim/Tenancy/Audit.

intentions.title: Let every plugin author a settings panel (typed form or raw JSON) without the Studio host knowing anything plugin-specific, and keep plugin credentials encrypted with audited reveal
intentions.evidence: settings_live.ex moduledoc: 'The host knows NOTHING about specific plugins' — typed form rendered generically from Plugins.Registry.collect_settings_schema/1 (labels, input types, :masked, :options, :required); credential values are masked by default and a reveal click records a reveal audit row; disabling a plugin is non-destructive (docs move to …Rest folder, never deleted).

intentions.title: Provide an in-Studio interactive API Docs + Playground so developers can explore and exercise the v1 API using their own real token, never an all-permissions god token
intentions.evidence: api_tester_live.ex: three-column endpoint browser/playground/response viewer; dispatch via :httpc server-side against the same running endpoint; comment 'Default the playground token to the CALLER'S OWN raw token ... never the all-perms barkpark-dev-token' to avoid leaking elevated authority into the form.
